ABOUT ZAPDOS LABS
 



  





 Zapdos Labs builds AI agents for factory and industrial operations. Our systems connect to existing cameras and operational data to help teams detect safety risks, understand production activity, investigate events, and act during the same shift.
 



  





 We combine modern multimodal AI with precise computer vision. Our agents do more than generate text: they watch video, consult procedures, use software tools, take approved actions, and report outcomes with supporting evidence.
 



  





 THE ROLE
 



  





 We are looking for a product\\-minded Full Stack Engineer to build AI agents and the applications through which factory teams configure, supervise, and use them.
 



  





 You will work across agent architecture, multimodal AI, backend services, integrations, and operator\\-facing applications. This is not primarily a dashboard role. You will build operational bots that can watch, reason, act, and report in real industrial environments.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL BUILD
 



 • Safety Officer Agents that detect hazards, reference the relevant SOP, save video evidence, alert supervisors, and track corrective action
 



 • Shift Supervisor Agents that monitor production, investigate interruptions, explain likely causes, and prepare shift handovers
 



 • Quality Inspector Agents that review production video, classify defects, track rejection rates, and identify process drift
 



 • Maintenance Agents that observe equipment state, investigate abnormal behavior, recommend actions, and create work orders
 



 • Inventory Agents that read labels, track movement, identify discrepancies, and maintain audit\\-ready records
 



 • Factory Assistants that answer operational questions using live events, historical video, SOPs, manuals, and production records
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL DO
 



 • Build multimodal agents that reason over video, images, documents, databases, and operational events
 



 • Design agent tools for searching video, querying logs, reading SOPs, creating reports, and sending alerts
 



 • Develop planning and orchestration flows for multi\\-step factory tasks
 



 • Build operator\\-facing chat, review, approval, and monitoring applications
 



 • Show users what an agent observed, why it reached a conclusion, and what action it took
 



 • Connect agents to cameras, computer vision models, customer documents, messaging systems, and factory software
 



 • Implement human\\-in\\-the\\-loop controls for sensitive or uncertain decisions
 



 • Build memory and context systems that preserve information across cameras, events, shifts, and facilities
 



 • Develop evaluations for reasoning quality, tool selection, task completion, latency, and reliability
 



 • Create guardrails that prevent unsupported conclusions or unsafe automated actions
 



 • Analyze failures and improve prompts, tools, models, retrieval, data, and application logic
 



 • Turn customer workflows into reusable agent capabilities instead of one\\-off demos
 



 • Deploy and monitor agents operating continuously in real customer environments
 



  





 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



 • Strong full\\-stack software engineering experience
 



 • Experience building production applications with LLMs, multimodal models, or agent frameworks
 



 • Ability to design reliable APIs, backend services, databases, and user interfaces
 



 • Understanding of tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, memory, and agent orchestration
 



 • Experience converting loosely defined user workflows into dependable software
 



 • Strong product judgment, especially around when an agent should act, ask, or escalate
 



 • Ability to debug failures across models, tools, data, prompts, and application code
 



 • Comfort working directly with customers and learning unfamiliar operational processes
 



 • Clear communication and reliable execution in an early\\-stage remote team
 



 • Careful handling of confidential customer video and operational information
 



  





 NICE TO HAVE
 



 • Experience with TypeScript, React, Python, PostgreSQL, or comparable technologies
 



 • Experience with vision\\-language models, video understanding, or computer vision
 



 • Familiarity with MCP, tool\\-calling APIs, workflow engines, or agent evaluation frameworks
 



 • Experience building copilots, autonomous workflows, or human\\-approval systems
 



 • Familiarity with streaming video, asynchronous jobs, and event\\-driven architectures
 



 • Experience integrating ERP, MES, CMMS, WMS, ticketing, or notification systems
 



 • Knowledge of manufacturing, logistics, workplace safety, or industrial maintenance
 



 • Experience deploying AI applications to edge devices or private customer environments
 



 • Familiarity with authentication, role\\-based access control, audit logs, and enterprise security
 



  





 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 



  





 During your first months, you will:
 



 • Ship an agent that completes a real factory workflow from observation to action
 



 • Connect the agent to video, operational documents, and at least one external tool
 



 • Build a clear interface for reviewing its evidence, reasoning, and actions
 



 • Establish repeatable evaluations for agent accuracy and task completion
 



 • Reduce the manual configuration needed when deploying to a new facility
 



  





 COMPENSATION AND STAGE
 



  





 Zapdos Labs is an early\\-stage company building production AI systems for industrial customers. Compensation includes cash based on experience and commitment, meaningful equity reflecting early technical ownership, flexible remote work, and direct influence over product and architecture.
 



  





 WHY THIS ROLE
 



  





 Most AI agents operate inside browsers and documents. Zapdos agents operate at the intersection of software and the physical world.
 



  





 You will build systems that observe real operations, reason through messy situations, and help factory teams make decisions during the same shift. The goal is not another chatbot. It is an operational teammate that factory personnel can understand and trust.

description:
We are looking for a
 **Senior PostgreSQL Database Engineer** 
 to own Our platform's relational data architecture, data integrity, query performance and database evolution.
 



**This is not a traditional DBA role.** 




 We are not primarily looking for someone to administer database servers, patch installations or manage user accounts. We need a hands\\-on PostgreSQL engineer who can design a production schema from the ground up, enforce data integrity at the database layer, analyze query execution plans, solve performance and concurrency problems, and safely evolve a live database as the platform scales.
 



 You will work closely with our Lead Full Stack Platform Engineer and Senior Backend Engineer.
 








**What You'll Do** 



* Own Our platform's
 **canonical PostgreSQL data model**
* Design schemas for investors, identity/KYC, organizations, properties, ownership, transactions, wallets, documents and audit/history records
* Define relationships, primary and foreign keys, constraints and appropriate data types
* Design tenant\\-aware data architecture and appropriate tenant\\-isolation patterns
* Establish database\\-level integrity controls for sensitive financial and ownership records
* Design transaction boundaries and consistency guarantees
* Handle concurrency using appropriate PostgreSQL isolation and locking strategies
* Diagnose and prevent race conditions, lock contention and deadlocks
* Design indexing strategies using:
* B\\-tree
* composite indexes
* partial indexes
* GIN/GiST/BRIN where justified
* Use
 **EXPLAIN and EXPLAIN ANALYZE** 
 to diagnose and optimize production queries
* Identify inefficient joins, N\\+1 access patterns and poor query plans
* Review
 **Prisma\\-generated SQL** 
 and identify when raw SQL or database\\-specific optimization is appropriate
* Design safe, backward\\-compatible
 **zero/low\\-downtime migrations**
* Develop migration rollback and recovery strategies
* Design database audit/history patterns appropriate for a regulated platform
* Establish connection\\-pooling strategies using PgBouncer or equivalent
* Establish database performance baselines and monitoring
* Use PostgreSQL statistics and tools such as pg\\_stat\\_statements to identify bottlenecks
* Plan backup, point\\-in\\-time recovery and disaster\\-recovery strategies
* Support database capacity planning as transaction and data volumes increase
* Work directly with backend engineers on API\\-to\\-schema contracts and transaction behavior








**Required Qualifications** 



* **4–8\\+ years** 
 of professional database, backend or data\\-platform engineering experience
* **Deep hands\\-on PostgreSQL production experience**
* Personally designed or significantly owned
 **PostgreSQL schemas for production applications**
* Strong relational data\\-modeling skills
* Advanced SQL proficiency
* Strong understanding of PostgreSQL constraints and referential integrity
* Hands\\-on experience with
 **EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN ANALYZE**
* Demonstrated production query optimization experience
* Strong indexing knowledge, including composite and partial indexes
* Practical understanding of PostgreSQL
 **MVCC**
* Experience with transaction isolation, concurrency, row\\-level locking and deadlock diagnosis
* Experience planning and executing migrations on active production databases
* Experience with connection pooling
* Experience with backup and recovery strategies
* Ability to collaborate with application engineers and translate application requirements into durable data models








**PostgreSQL is non\\-negotiable** 




 This is not a generic relational\\-database position.
 



 Candidates whose experience is primarily
 **SQL Server, Oracle or MySQL without substantial production PostgreSQL ownership** 
 are unlikely to be a fit.
 



 We specifically need someone who understands PostgreSQL deeply enough to explain not only
 **what** 
 query or schema change should be made, but
 **why PostgreSQL is behaving the way it is** 
 .
 








**Preferred** 



* AWS
 **RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL**
* pg\\_stat\\_statements
* PgBouncer
* PostgreSQL partitioning
* Point\\-in\\-time recovery
* Large production database migrations
* Multi\\-tenant SaaS data architecture
* Financial transaction, payments, investment or ledger\\-like data models
* Immutable/auditable data\\-history patterns
* Fintech, regulated SaaS or digital\\-asset platforms
* Prisma ORM and experience reviewing ORM\\-generated SQL
* Basic Node.js/TypeScript familiarity sufficient to work effectively with backend engineers
* Database observability using CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog or equivalent
* Experience using AI\\-assisted engineering tools while independently validating generated schemas, SQL and optimization recommendations








**What You Are Not Expected to Own** 




 You do not need to be the primary Node.js application developer. The Senior Backend Engineer owns services, APIs and business logic.
 



 You also do not need Solidity or ERC\\-3643 experience. Blockchain development is a separate specialist function.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 A backend engineer should be able to bring you a new Our platform workflow and rely on you to determine:
 



**How should this data actually be modeled? What invariants belong in PostgreSQL? How do we prevent inconsistent ownership or transaction records? How will this query behave at 10× or 100× the volume? And how do we change the schema later without disrupting production?** 




 That is the level of database ownership we're looking for.
